newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower on currency.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower on currency.

text.p: A stronger sterling against the mark kept UK grain futures prices on the downside on Friday.
Prices tried to rally in early dealings following Thursday's sharp falls after the result of the EU weekly grain tender but a stronger currency forced prices lower.
Wheat closed 0.50 to 0.25 stg down after trading 709 lots while barley was one stg lower on 19 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures closed unchanged after trading four lots, all in October.
The UK cash sector was quiet with fob traders reporting two feed wheat trades for Dec at 108.50 stg and Jan/Mar at 110 stg ex-east coast ports.
Delivered business was quiet with only a few light trades reported.
